system.description:
“Come on Sutemaru, let's sniff these guys out,” Aria says while petting the head of her ninja-dog who’s sniffing some left behind tents. “Are we sure he can find them? I mean, he’s not all that smart” Aria’s teammate Levi says while looking unamused at the ninja dog sniff through random objects. As Sutemaru begins to dig at the ground directly under him. “See he just wants to play. Dumb dog” Levi says as he begins to walk away annoyed the dog's antics. “Hey don’t be mean to him, He’s trying-” Aria begins before she is cut off by Sutemaru and starts scratching at Metal beneath the dirt. “You’ve gotta be kidding me…” Levi says while looking in complete disbelief. “Told you to give him a chance. He’s a good boy!”

—Tatsunami Aburame

The Long Road, Ch. 1 excerpt.

While traveling with man's best friend, a ninken (or ninja dog). Exploring the countryside, training together and understanding one another and growing close enough to know what the other is thinking is the bond Inuzuka’s share with their Ning-Dog and one another.

The Most Loyal

The Inuzuka Clan or Inuzuka Family is a family of shinobi in Konoha known for their use of ninja-dogs as fighting companions and are easily identified by the distinctive red fang markings on their cheeks. The members are given their own canine partner(s) when they reach a certain age. Thereafter, the shinobi and their dog(s) are practically inseparable. The shinobi and canine allies fight using Cooperation Ninjutsu, which takes advantage of their teamwork and their sharp claws and teeth. The clan members are also able to communicate with canines. The members of this clan, much like their canine partners, have greatly enhanced senses, especially their sense of smell.

Inuzuka Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Str or Dex, +1 Wis

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling, Survival

Beast Speak: You can speak to & understand creatures designated as Beasts.

Inuzuka Hijutsu: The Inuzuka Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Inuzuka Clan Hijutsu can use either Strength or Wisdom as its casting ability score.

Inuzuka Features

Four-Legs Technique

1st Level Clan Feature

Your clans unique fighting style has you fighting like a rabid beast with claws and fangs. Sharpened nails and teeth allows you to fight like a hunter, a predator, a Dog. While in combat, you can drop down on all fours and enter the Four-Legs Taijutsu stance. While in this stance, you gain the following benefits:

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 2d4, and damage type becomes Slashing. This becomes 4d4 at 11th level.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for attacks and damage.

Your speed increased by +10, and you don’t spend extra movement when Wall or Water Walking.

You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

Beast Master

1st Level Clan Feature

As per clan tradition, you were raised with a canine companion, bred by the Inuzuka clan known as a Nin-Dog. Your Nin-Dog has its own stats detailed as part of this clan but can be one of many breeds that determines its unique traits.

Your Nin-Dog is friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. In combat, it acts as part of your turn, but has its own reaction, which it can spend to cast Hijutsu you know with the [Tag-Team] keyword. You can command your Nin-Dog in one of the following ways:

Move. At no action cost to you, you can command your Nin-Dog to move its full movement.

Strike. As part of an attack made with your Attack action or a Jutsu you cast that makes attacks, you can forgo any number of attacks to command your Nin-Dog to use its Bite attack.

Synchronize. As part of casting a Jutsu with the Tag-Team keyword, your dog can spend a Jutsu slot casting the same jutsu, but using the Tag Team effect.

Hunt. As a Bonus action, you can command your Nin-Dog to perform any of its special abilities, Dash, Disengage, Hide, Help or perform a skill-based action in place of you while exploring or not in combat.

Your Nin-Dog has Jutsu slots like a summoned creature and regains them when he completes a rest of any type. When you are incapacitated or unconscious, your Nin-Dog can act on its own, and uses its turns to defend you and itself to the best of its abilities. If your Nin-Dog is reduced to 0 hit points, it makes Death saving throws like a player character would. If your Nin-Dog dies, over the course of a Full-Rest, while you are with the Inuzuka clan, you perform a secret ritual that provides you a similar Nin-Dog of the same breed, level and the same traits as your previous one.

Your Nin-Dog is treated as the same level as you and gains special traits as it grows in level with you. It starts small in size and grows to medium at 7th level and large at 15th. When you would gain the Ability score increase/Feat at levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 19, it also increases one of its ability modifiers and their associated saves by +1 of your choice up to a max of +6.

Beginning at character creation, you must first select your Dogs breed between the following list, and then select an additional trait from the Traits section at the end of this clan section. It gains one more trait at 7th and 15th levels.

Inuit. A breed known for its hunting skill. Gains proficiency in Survival and the Wild Sense trait.

Kugsha. A breed known for combat. Gains proficiency in Intimidation and the Ravage trait.

Tamaskan. A breed known for its ability to mold chakra. Gains proficiency in Chakra Control and the Paw-Signs trait.

Shiba. A breed known for its chameleon like fur. Gains proficiency in Stealth and the Silent Paw trait.

Akita. A breed known for its size and strength. Gains proficiency in Athletics and the Grit trait.

Savage Attacker

| #### Feral / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Rabid. You gain a +2 bonus to your AC and Dexterity saving throws. / Ferocious. You increase damage you deal by +1 damage die. If multiple damage die of different sizes are rolled, add one additional die of the largest size. / Hunting. You are always s aware of the location of creatures with less than full hit points so long as they are within 60 feet of you. / Calming. You exit Feral at the end of your next turn. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

You and your Nin-Dog carry within them the savage fighting spirit of the Inuzuka. When you and your Nin-Dog are on opposite sides of a creatures, the first attack roll either of you make is at advantage, once per turn.

When either you or your Nin-Dog scores a critical hit, you become Feral.

Beginning at 11th level, when either you or your Nin-Dog falls below half of your maximum hit points, you become Feral for the next minute ignoring the Calming effect for the duration. Once you enter Feral in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

Nin-Dog

Beast

Armor Class 10 + Dexterity Mod + your proficiency bonus

Hit Points (10 + Con Mod) times level.

Jutsu Slots 2 + Half Level (Min 1)

Speed 35 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +2 | + | CON | +2 | + | WIS | +2 | + |

| DEX | +2 | + | INT | +0 | + | CHA | +1 | + |

Save Proficiencies Strength, Dexterity, Wisdom (Add your Prof bonus with the listed Mod to calculate their Save Bonus. All others, only add half your prof bonus.)

Skills Acrobatics, Perception, Insight

Senses Darkvision 30 ft., Keen Smell & Hearing (Advantage on Perception checks to Smell or Hear something)

Nin-Dog Traits

Tag-Team. The Nin-Dog can cast any jutsu its master knows with the Tag-Team keyword when commanded to Synchronize.

Masters Strength. If a jutsu your Nin-Dog casts with the Tag-Team keyword requires a saving throw, they can use your Taijutsu Save DC, or their own Jutsu Save DC, whichever is higher.

Own Strength. The Nin-Dog uses either its Strength or Dexterity to determine its Jutsu save DC.

Attacks

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: 5ft., one target. Str+ Prof to hit, 1d6+Mod Piercing damage. This increases to 2d6 at 11th level.

Beast Human Clone

7th Level Clan Feature

When initiative is rolled, your Nin-Dog uses the advanced transformation technique, transforming to look exactly like you, with notable differences. While transformed, creatures cannot discern between either of you without Chakra Sight and your Nin-Dog gains the benefit of your Four-Legs Taijutsu stance and can become Feral when you do.

Beast Sense

11th Level Clan Feature

You have learned to imitate your Nin-Dogs sensory capabilities with your chakra. You gain a rank of Mastery in Perception, Insight, and Survival. Skill-based actions using those skills that take an action, now cost a Bonus action instead.

Two-Headed Wolf

15th Level Clan Feature

As a bonus action, you perform the Inuzuka Clans Secret Transformation Technique, fusing you and your dog, and transforming you both into a huge creature with 2 heads and combining your senses and strengths. You grow one size larger than your Nin-Dog up to a maximum size of Huge. You remain in this form for 1 minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a long rest.

While fused with your Nin-Dog, you use the Two-Headed Wolf stat block. When you fall to 0 hit points while in this state, you immediately end the fusion, separating back into two separate creatures. Your Nin-Dog has 1 hit point, and you have half of your maximum hit points.

Two-Headed Wolf

Beast

Armor Class 15 + Proficiency bonus or Your AC, whichever is higher

Hit Points 8 x Level

Speed 60 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +6 | + | CON | +6 | + | WIS | + | + |

| DEX | +6 | + | INT | + | + | CHA | + | + |

Damage Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing

Condition Immunities Bruised, Weakened

Senses All of your Nin-Dogs Senses, plus your own.

Shared Body. While in this state, you gain an additional action, which you can only use to cast a jutsu with the Tag-Team keyword again on the same turn. When you do, you can only use its Tag-Team effect.

Shared Fortitude. You gain all resistances and immunities you had prior to the fusion.

Shared Mind. You use your or your Nin-Dogs ability modifiers for Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma while in this state, whichever is higher.

Shared Strength. You gain the benefits of your Nin-Dogs traits where applicable.

Class Limits. You can use your Class and clan features while in this state. Your Bite is treated as both a weapon and unarmed attack. Taking the attack action allows you to make attacks with your Bite. If your Weapon had Seals, your Bite inherits their effects.

Inherent Knowledge. You can still cast jutsu you know ignoring hand signs when needed.

Attacks

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: 5ft., one target. Str or Dex + Prof to hit, 2d12+Mod Piercing damage.

Nin-Dog Traits

Wild Sense

Your Nin-Dog can sniff out creatures even when they have covered their tracks. As a bonus action, the Nin-Dog raises its snout to the air and takes a single sniff. It becomes aware of all creatures within 60 feet of it and their current locations. Creatures that were previously Undetected drops down to being only Unseen. This increases to 120 feet at 7th level and 1 Mile at 15th level.

This does not identify a creature and does not reveal creatures submerged in water, underground, within buildings or using jutsu based effects to hide or mask themselves. Once they use this trait, they cannot do so again until 10 minutes pass.

Ravage

Your Nin-Dog becomes a four-legged feral beast, able to tear chunks out of wood or rock. Your Nin-Dogs Bite increases its damage die by 1 step. You can take this trait more than once increasing the die step each time, to a max size of d12.

Once per turn, as part of the Strike command, your Nin-Dog makes one additional Bite attack.

Paw-Signs

Your Nin-Dog weaves its paws like hand signs creating complex motions completely throwing you off. Select two Ninjutsu that you would normally qualify for of D-Rank. Your Nin-Dog learns it and you gain the Cast command. Your Nin-Dog continues its studies learning one additional jutsu at 7th and 15th levels.

Cast. As a bonus action, you command your Nin-Dog to cast a jutsu it knows.

You can take this trait more than once, increasing the rank of jutsu your Nin-Dog can learn by one grade, to a max rank of A-Rank.

Silent Paw

Your Nin-Dogs paw pads are soft, quiet and their nails make no clacking sound when they step. They gain a rank of mastery in Stealth. As part of the Hunt command, they can attempt to Hide while they are lightly obscured. On a success, they also gain the benefits of the Dash action and don’t lose the benefits being hidden when moving more than half their speed.

Grit

Your Nin-Dogs is built stoneface tough. With a body like a tailed beast, your Nin-Dog can truck through any harm that comes to it. Increase its hit points by an amount equal to twice its level. Whenever it gains a level thereafter, its hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit point.

Additionally, it gains proficiency in Constitution saving throws and Damage Reduction (DR) equal to its constitution ability modifier.

Savage

Your Nin-Dog lives and breathes violence. You often consider getting it a muzzle, just in case. Creatures that cast jutsu with the Hand sign (HS) component makes your Nin-Dog see red, allowing it to spend its reaction to move and then make a Bite attack against them before the effects of the triggering jutsu is applied.

You can take this trait more than once, increasing the number of attacks it makes as part of this reaction by +1, up to a max of 3 attacks.

Barker

Your Nin-Dogs bark is just are ferocious as its bite. Your Nin-Dog gains the Bark attack. It can use this Bark attack in place of its Bite.

Bark. Ranged Taijutsu Save: 15ft., one target. The affected target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it gains a rank of Demoralized.

Talker

Your Nin-Dog isn’t only man’s best friend. It can also talk!? Your Nin-Dog can speak in a language that everyone can understand. It gain proficiency in the Persuasion and Deception skills. It will never lie to you, but will always lie to others if it believes the truth will bring you harm in any way.

Skilled

Your Nin-Dog is very versatile. It gains proficiency in 4 skills of your choice.

You can take this trait more than once. When you do, select 4 more skills your Nin-Dog gains proficiency in. They also gain a rank of Mastery in all skills they had prior to gaining the 4 new skills.

Big Boy/Girl

Your Nin-Dogs is definitely getting three square meals. Increase your Nin-Dogs size by one category. If your Nin-Dog would grow in size on their own to a defined size, they instead grow to the next size category due to this trait. You also gain the Shrink Boy/Girl command.

Additionally, when your Nin-Dog attacks a creature smaller than it, it gains a rank of Mastery to its attack and damage rolls.

Shrink Boy/Girl. As an Action, you command your Nin-Dog to shrink down 1 size category. They can remain this smaller size indefinitely until commanded again to regain their larger size.
